_notes: Stern SAM AT91R40008 @ 40MHz, 128KB of NVRAM at address 0x02100000.
Multiple areas of RAM according to PinMAME.
The RAM entries bound what a map is allowed to read, not what the machine has: PinMAME's CPU
image for these games is 80MB, and game state has been found well outside the two 64K windows
originally listed here -- X-Men counts its ball at 0x00030AE5. Main RAM is widened to 1MB to
cover it. Widening only permits reads; it cannot change how any existing field decodes.
